summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Direxion Daily Mid Cap Bull 3X ETF (MIDU) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Mid Cap 400 index. The fund provides 3x leveraged exposure to a market cap-weighted index of US mid-cap companies. MIDU was launched on Jan 8, 2009 and is issued by Direxion.

holdings.infoBox: MIDU is an equity ETF with a total of 406 individual holdings. The top holdings are MID SWAP ASSET LEG stock at 222.43%, GOLDMAN FINL SQ TRSRY INST 506 at 15.51%, DREYFUS GOVT CASH MAN INS at 8.43%, Twilio at 1.00%, and Okta, Inc. at 0.76%.
